mechanism: Venlafaxine inhibits platelet aggregation through serotonin reuptake inhibition, which may increase bleeding risk; zoledronic acid can cause electrolyte disturbances and renal impairment that affect venlafaxine clearance.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding, ensure adequate hydration during zoledronic acid infusion, and assess renal function regularly as both drugs can affect kidney function and venlafaxine metabolism.
